name: alpe-gestion
description: Sistema de gestión B2B para ALPE: costos, precios, pedidos, despachos, inventario, producción, maquila y cartera.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
